_provenance.label: raw/ = sha256-verified originals (M366); apparent battery-side KE recovery with assumed masses (observed, not SOC-standardized); interval-based extractor v2; not a correction of the legacy values

stageMB_S1.note: stage MB variant VCa (RPM known + contiguous rows + ages <= 5 s + full probes + start-speed binning on the speed view) on the legacy extractor; step S1 of the bridge

legacyComparison.bridgeNote: S0 = published legacy; S1 = stage MB fixes on the legacy extractor; S2 = v2 intervals, strict drops only, end speed > 0, END-speed bins; S3 = + intervals ending at standstill; S4 = + inner plateaus (KE 0, charge kept); S5 = + instantaneous-speed binning (the v2 primary table). S2-S5 are masks over the v2 intervals; they are not a decomposition into independent effects (the steps interact) and not corrections.

sensitivities.note: sensitivity of the v2 estimate to declared conventions: I/V time shifted by +1 s / -1 s (BMS versus speed polling lag) and a 2 s ceiling on the speed interval and on the I/V bracket gap; differences are ranges over conventions, not confidence intervals

cadenceInvariance.rule: per cell: the paired difference (full minus decimated), mean of the two phases, with a day-clustered 95 % interval from the same resamples; a cell FAILS cadence invariance if the interval excludes zero AND |difference| exceeds the half-width of the cell's assumed-mass range; if any SUPPORTED cell (full-run fast subset) of a decision view (temperature all-SOC, speed all-SOC, SOC-band totals) fails, stage ME is blocked until the Director rules; other cells are reported only

plateauDiagnostic.note: paired full-minus-half-rate difference of the pooled ratio on the fast-cadence drives under three interval populations; a difference that appears only when plateau intervals are included points at the plateau / episode rule, not at the interpolation
